| 5 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | James Wan | Paranormal investigation |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | David Robert Mitchell | Viral curse with a relentless stalker |
| 7 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Ari Aster | Daylight horror, cult rituals |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | Psychological horror about grief |
| 9 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Gore Verbinski | Viral curse + supernatural dread |
|10 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Oren Peli | Found‑footage realism |
